encode_sentence_with_bart: BPE-encode a sentence into a torch LongTensor using the BART hub interface
decode_tokens_with_bart: Decode a torch LongTensor of tokens back into a human-readable sentence
generate_text_with_bart: Generate text hypotheses from a list of tokenized input sentences using BART
extract_features_with_bart: Extract BART model features or all hidden states from tokenized input
fill_mask_with_bart: Fill masked tokens in input text with top-k predicted token candidates
